description: Defines an ErrorDialog class for displaying a fullscreen error dialog with up to 3 buttons in an Android application, including builder pattern for configuration.

classes.name: ErrorDialog
classes.description: A custom dialog class for showing error messages with optional buttons.

classes.name: Builder
classes.description: Builder pattern class for constructing ErrorDialog instances.

methods.name: onCreate
methods.description: Initializes the dialog UI, sets image, message, and buttons based on parameters.

methods.name: setMessage
methods.description: Sets the message ID for the error dialog.

methods.name: addButton
methods.description: Adds a button with specified ID and label to the dialog.

methods.name: setButtonClickListener
methods.description: Sets the click listener for dialog buttons.

methods.name: setOnDismissListener
methods.description: Sets the dismiss listener for the dialog.

methods.name: create
methods.description: Creates an ErrorDialog instance with the configured parameters.
